CBI arrests two in murder of Suvendu Adhikari's aide, probes political links

The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has arrested two individuals in connection with the murder of an aide to West Bengal politician Suvendu Adhikari. The arrested individuals are allegedly linked to a rival political party. Investigators are examining the political angle in the case, with reports indicating the accused brothers had previously worked with the victim. The CBI's investigation is focused on establishing these political connections.
